title: Integrate onto a fetched main that passed the local head
goal: local-workflow integrate builds on a main that moved through a push made elsewhere instead of refusing every claim based on that main, so a harness landing no longer needs an operator to move the local integration head after another agent pushes.

reuse.searched: xtask/src/local_workflow/gates.rs (claim_base, fetched_main, receipt_matches), xtask/src/local_workflow/ship.rs (record_acceptance and its publish-base rule) and xtask/src/local_workflow/sync_commit.rs (integrate_many_with).
reuse.reason: integrate now calls the existing claim_base rule that new claims already start from, and records the base in its receipt the way ship records its publish base; no new mechanism, 45 lines including the test.

integration.workflow: susi harness run (mission core-integrate-main), native local workflow integrate

results.worker: governed subscription worker, one attempt, landed on the first pass
results.validated_before_the_worker_ran: the new test fails without the change with the exact refusal message and passes with it; the 96 local_workflow tests pass
results.found_by: three harness landings in a row were refused with: integration history does not contain the claim base; reconcile explicitly
